title: Personal rules: a risk line states in its label whether it is open or fixed
story: The personal rules orion offers now ask that a risk line say in its label whether the risk is still open or already fixed (Risk (open): / Risk (fixed):), so a reader never mistakes a solved problem for a live one. People on an older copy are offered the change once.
no_qa_reason: Rules text people are offered; nothing to drive. Suite checks guard the label wording and the offer logic.
